lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured lattice of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 12 vertical columns and 5-6 horizontal rows between the pectoral fin and the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a grid-like pattern, with circular blobs localized within the resulting rectangular partitions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible across the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-10 high-luminance blobs are visible, scattered irregularly across the mid-to-posterior section of the first dorsal fin's lateral silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance fusiform shapes (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and along the lateral midline.
